generic_domain.value: adversarial attacks in natural language processing
generic_domain.justification: The term 'adversarial attacks in natural language processing' is the most comprehensive because it broadly covers any adversarial attack within NLP, including those related to text and various detection methods. The other domains are either repetitions ('adversarial attacks in nlp') or more specific subsets focusing on detection ('textual adversarial attack detection'). Thus, this domain can encompass all others listed.
